[SWS_DM_00888] Observability of indicator status
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04204
⌈
The DM shall provide the status of an indicator via the function
ara::diag::Indi-
cator::GetIndicatorState
of the corresponding
ara::diag::Indicator
in-
stance.
⌋
The status of an indicator is determined by all the event indicator status combined to
the DTC for which the indicator state is requested.
